name: Jordan Rivera
summary:
Jordan Rivera. Senior at State University, Math and CS, graduating June 2027. Based in Springfield, IL. Seeking entry-level full-time roles.
Track A: software engineering, AI engineering, automation, full-stack, forward deployed. Track B: solutions, sales engineer, technical BD, implementation.
Location preference: Chicago, then Remote (US), Dallas, New Jersey (pay-dependent), California.
Skills: TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, React, Python, SQL, Playwright browser automation, Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, LLM evals, prompt design, PDF extraction.
Experience: built and runs Example Labs, an AI automation business for compliance-heavy firms (logistics, accounting, recruiting, property management). Built compliance automation for a logistics firm covering customs and freight filings. Built an invoice extractor that pulled 260+ filings with zero errors. Reached 300+ building owners through outreach. Freelance web developer: client sites with Lighthouse scores of 90+ performance and 100 accessibility, best practices and SEO. Cold outreach, discovery calls, client scoping and delivery.
Not a fit: roles requiring 3+ years, senior or lead titles, roles needing security clearance or a PhD.
goal: My main goal is building my own business, Example Labs. I want a job with base pay of at least $115,000 that is remote or hybrid and leaves room to run Example Labs in parallel.
